detail.body:
## Description

Backport [sgl-project/sglang#44014](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44014)
as an explicit AReaL source patch for SM90 FlashInfer GDN decode.

With padded decode CUDA Graphs, `cache_indices` contains `-1`. The SM90
Python gather/scatter path treats it as the last real state-pool slot.
Padded lanes can therefore overwrite live or cached recurrent state,
causing intermittent corrupted output in subsequent generation.

The backport passes the full pool and int32 indices to FlashInfer's indexed
decode API. It preserves the SM100+ branch, prefill and MTP code. It uses
AReaL's existing atomic, locked source-patch installer, validates input/output
hashes, refuses unknown sources, and is idempotent.

Apply **before starting servers**, in the SGLang interpreter:

```bash
python -m areal.engine.sglang_gdn_decode_padding
```

A disposable source copy can be checked without local GPU dependencies:

```bash
python -m areal.engine.sglang_gdn_decode_padding --target /path/to/gdn_flashinfer.py
```

**Runtime boundary:** installed application requires a separately provisioned
FlashInfer >= 0.6.18 runtime. AReaL currently pins SGLang 0.5.10.post1 with
FlashInfer 0.6.7.post3; that older FlashInfer is rejected before any write.
This PR does not change dependency pins or auto-enable the patch. Source
hashes cover SGLang 0.5.10.post1, 0.5.20 and the original upstream PR base
module, with the same SM90 fix adapted to their different call sites.

## Related Issue

Upstream fix: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44014 (still open).

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix

## Validation

- 13 CPU tests passed, including the negative-index call contract, idempotent
  writes, permission preservation, unknown-source refusal and runtime guards.
- SM90 GPU regressions passed for all three source profiles with FlashInfer
  0.6.18: 2 test methods per profile, covering BF16/FP32 states, int32/int64
  indices, eager decode and CUDA Graph replay with changing index patterns.
  Checks include untouched live slots, especially the last allocatable slot,
  and valid-row state/output agreement with an unpadded reference.
- Changed-file pre-commit hooks and normal commit hooks passed.
- `pre-commit run --all-files` was attempted. Its project-wide manifest/CLI
  hooks could not pass in the minimal Python 3.10 check environment:
  `tomllib` and `httpx` were unavailable, and `uv` was not on the hook PATH.
  Formatting, linting, license and other source checks passed. The GPU tests
  used a separate Python 3.12 runtime. Full training/distributed integration
  was not run for this standalone source backport.

## Checklist

- [x] I have read the contributing guide.
- [x] Relevant tests pass; regression tests added.
- [x] Usage and runtime requirements documented in the patch module.
- [x] Branch is based on the checked upstream main commit.
- [ ] Full repository pre-commit checks pass in a complete development environment.

Prepared with coding-agent assistance; public code and synthetic regression
inputs only.

@@ -0,0 +1,184 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Opt-in backport of https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44014.
+
+SM90 decode must pass CUDA Graph padding (-1) to FlashInfer's indexed state
+pool API. Python gather/scatter instead aliases the last allocatable slot.
+
+Apply in the interpreter that will run SGLang, before starting any servers::
+
+    python -m areal.engine.sglang_gdn_decode_padding
+
+Requires a separately provisioned FlashInfer >= 0.6.18 runtime. The default
+AReaL dependency pins are unchanged; their FlashInfer 0.6.7.post3 is rejected.
+Validated source profiles: SGLang 0.5.10.post1, 0.5.20, and the upstream PR
+base module. Unknown and locally modified sources are rejected before writing.
+Use ``--target PATH`` to patch a disposable source copy without importing or
+checking the local GPU dependencies. Repeated application is write-free.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import re
+from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from areal.engine._sglang_source_patch import (
+    install_source_patches,
+    installed_sglang_root,
+    patch_source,
+)
+
+TARGET_RELATIVE = Path("srt/layers/attention/linear/kernels/gdn_flashinfer.py")
+MIN_FLASHINFER_VERSION = (0, 6, 18)
+
+PINNED_OLD = """\
+        else:
+            # TODO: Once FlashInfer PR#2521 is merged for SM90, gather/scatter
+            # will no longer be needed here.
+            state_batch = ssm_states[cache_indices]
+            output_fi, new_state = self._decode_fn(
+                q=query_fi,
+                k=key_fi,
+                v=value_fi,
+                state=state_batch,
+                A_log=A_log.detach(),
+                a=a_fi,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias.detach(),
+                b=b_fi,
+                scale=None,
+                output=None,
+                use_qk_l2norm=True,
+            )
+            ssm_states[cache_indices] = new_state
+"""
+
+PINNED_NEW = """\
+        else:
+            # Keep -1 as padding instead of indexing the last live pool slot.
+            cache_indices_fi = cache_indices.to(dtype=torch.int32)
+            output_fi, _ = self._decode_fn(
+                q=query_fi,
+                k=key_fi,
+                v=value_fi,
+                state=None,
+                A_log=A_log.detach(),
+                a=a_fi,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias.detach(),
+                b=b_fi,
+                use_qk_l2norm=True,
+                initial_state=ssm_states,
+                initial_state_indices=cache_indices_fi,
+            )
+"""
+
+DYNAMIC_OLD = """\
+        else:
+            # TODO: Once FlashInfer PR#2521 is merged for SM90, gather/scatter
+            # will no longer be needed here.
+            state_batch = ssm_states[cache_indices]
+            output_fi, new_state = self._decode_fn(
+                q=query_fi,
+                k=key_fi,
+                v=value_fi,
+                state=state_batch,
+                A_log=A_log_fi,
+                a=a_fi,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias_fi,
+                b=b_fi,
+                scale=None,
+                output=None,
+                use_qk_l2norm=True,
+            )
+            ssm_states[cache_indices] = new_state
+"""
+
+DYNAMIC_NEW = """\
+        else:
+            # Keep -1 as padding instead of indexing the last live pool slot.
+            cache_indices_fi = cache_indices.to(dtype=torch.int32)
+            cache_indices_fi = self._prepare_dynamic_input(
+                "decode_cache_indices", cache_indices_fi
+            )
+            output_fi, _ = self._decode_fn(
+                q=query_fi,
+                k=key_fi,
+                v=value_fi,
+                state=None,
+                A_log=A_log_fi,
+                a=a_fi,
+                dt_bias=dt_bias_fi,
+                b=b_fi,
+                use_qk_l2norm=True,
+                initial_state=ssm_states,
+                initial_state_indices=cache_indices_fi,
+            )
+"""
+
+_PATCHES = {
+    "9534205439e1408129e9bfb38a2e2b963d030c08d287a493517531a5d2e6b749": (
+        PINNED_OLD,
+        PINNED_NEW,
+        "e2dbb29f33f6a8d65633ed46fcd650e0e854ed142d925e8b8117f14e0fe232af",
+    ),
+    "6db787654af7953b5572520b9b1b048f8939e3587e8fdb287e82bcce4d168b02": (
+        DYNAMIC_OLD,
+        DYNAMIC_NEW,
+        "57739cd4105ff1926f54ee9e807cf60785a6b639389a0e8b3141b137b1b8c217",
+    ),
+    "2a3092cef9ac5493ae2a52bb3dd129c729df44782bc27886935efac842687e02": (
+        DYNAMIC_OLD,
+        DYNAMIC_NEW,
+        "e08981fcda1101208965f1ba4c805482457ee00d33bafe07bfdae4d6a36054f0",
+    ),
+}
+
+
+def patched_source(source: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Apply the SM90-only backport to a known source, preserving other paths."""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()
+    if digest in {profile[2] for profile in _PATCHES.values()}:
+        return source
+    if digest not in _PATCHES:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Unknown SGLang gdn_flashinfer.py source; refusing to modify"
+        )
+    old, new, patched_digest = _PATCHES[digest]
+    return patch_source(
+        source,
+        target_relative=TARGET_RELATIVE,
+        replacements_by_sha256={digest: [(old, new)]},
+        patched_sha256=patched_digest,
+    )
+
+
+def validate_flashinfer_version() -> None:
+    """Reject old or unrecognized runtimes before changing installed source."""
+    try:
+        installed = version("flashinfer-python")
+    except PackageNotFoundError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError("FlashInfer >= 0.6.18 is required for this patch") from exc
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)(?:\.post\d+)?", installed)
+    if match is None or tuple(map(int, match.groups())) < MIN_FLASHINFER_VERSION:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"FlashInfer >= 0.6.18 is required for this patch; found {installed}. "
+            "Use a separately provisioned runtime before applying this backport."
+        )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--target", type=Path, help="Disposable source copy")
+    target = parser.parse_args().target
+    if target is None:
+        validate_flashinfer_version()
+        root = installed_sglang_root()
+        target = root / TARGET_RELATIVE
+    else:
+        root = target.parent
+    install_source_patches(
+        [(target, patched_source)], lock_path=root / ".areal-sglang-patches.lock"
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+import hashlib
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from areal.engine import sglang_gdn_decode_padding as patch
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=["PINNED", "DYNAMIC"])
+def source_profile(request, monkeypatch):
+    """Exercise both source call sites without optional GPU imports."""
+    old = getattr(patch, request.param + "_OLD")
+    new = getattr(patch, request.param + "_NEW")
+    source = (
+        "class Kernel:\n"
+        "    def _prepare_dynamic_input(self, name, value):\n"
+        "        return value\n"
+        "    def decode(self, cache_indices, ssm_states):\n"
+        "        query_fi = key_fi = value_fi = a_fi = b_fi = None\n"
+        "        A_log_fi = dt_bias_fi = A_log = dt_bias = scalar\n"
+        "        if self.use_state_pool:\n"
+        "            return 'unchanged-blackwell-path'\n"
+        + old
+        + "\n        return output_fi\n"
+    ).encode()
+    expected = source.replace(old.encode(), new.encode())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        patch,
+        "_PATCHES",
+        {
+            hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(): (
+                old,
+                new,
+                hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        },
+    )
+    return source, expected
+
+
+def test_padding_reaches_indexed_kernel_without_python_pool_access(source_profile):
+    """The old call site touches the pool with -1; the backport must not."""
+
+    class Pool:
+        def __getitem__(self, index):
+            raise AssertionError("Python pool access would alias the final live slot")
+
+        def __setitem__(self, index, value):
+            raise AssertionError("Python scatter would overwrite the final live slot")
+
+    class Indices:
+        def __init__(self, values, dtype):
+            self.values = values
+            self.dtype = dtype
+
+        def to(self, *, dtype):
+            return Indices(self.values, dtype)
+
+    scalar = SimpleNamespace(detach=lambda: scalar)
+    source, expected = source_profile
+    namespace = {"torch": SimpleNamespace(int32="int32"), "scalar": scalar}
+    exec(compile(source, "unpatched.py", "exec"), namespace)
+    kernel = namespace["Kernel"]()
+    kernel.use_state_pool = False
+    pool = Pool()
+    indices = Indices([1, -1, 3, -1], "int64")
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="final live slot"):
+        kernel.decode(indices, pool)
+
+    patched = patch.patched_source(source)
+    assert patched == expected
+    assert patch.patched_source(patched) == patched
+    exec(compile(patched, "patched.py", "exec"), namespace)
+    kernel = namespace["Kernel"]()
+    kernel.use_state_pool = False
+    calls = []
+
+    def decode(**kwargs):
+        assert kwargs["state"] is None
+        assert kwargs["initial_state"] is pool
+        assert kwargs["initial_state_indices"].values == indices.values
+        assert kwargs["initial_state_indices"].dtype == "int32"
+        calls.append(kwargs)
+        return "output", None
+
+    kernel._decode_fn = decode
+    assert kernel.decode(indices, pool) == "output"
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+    kernel.use_state_pool = True
+    assert kernel.decode(indices, pool) == "unchanged-blackwell-path"
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+
+
+def test_target_copy_is_idempotent_without_gpu_dependencies(
+    source_profile, tmp_path, monkeypatch
+):
+    """Offline application keeps file permissions and avoids a second write."""
+    source, expected = source_profile
+    target = tmp_path / "gdn_flashinfer.py"
+    target.write_bytes(source)
+    target.chmod(0o640)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["patch", "--target", str(target)])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        patch,
+        "validate_flashinfer_version",
+        lambda: pytest.fail("GPU dependency access"),
+    )
+    patch.main()
+    assert target.read_bytes() == expected
+    assert target.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o640
+    modified = target.stat().st_mtime_ns
+    patch.main()
+    assert target.stat().st_mtime_ns == modified
+
+
+def test_unknown_source_is_not_modified(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """A new or locally modified SGLang module needs explicit validation."""
+    target = tmp_path / "gdn_flashinfer.py"
+    target.write_bytes(b"# unsupported source\n")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["patch", "--target", str(target)])
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Unknown SGLang"):
+        patch.main()
+    assert target.read_bytes() == b"# unsupported source\n"
+    assert not (tmp_path / ".areal-sglang-patches.lock").exists()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("installed", ["0.6.7.post3", "0.6.17", "0.6.18rc1", "dev"])
+def test_unsupported_flashinfer_is_rejected_before_source_access(
+    monkeypatch, installed
+):
+    """The default older dependency pins cannot accidentally receive this patch."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(patch, "version", lambda _: installed)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        patch, "installed_sglang_root", lambda: pytest.fail("source accessed")
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["patch"])
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="FlashInfer >= 0.6.18"):
+        patch.main()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("installed", ["0.6.18", "0.6.18.post1", "0.7.1"])
+def test_supported_flashinfer_passes_version_guard(monkeypatch, installed):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(patch, "version", lambda _: installed)
+    patch.validate_flashinfer_version()
+
+
+def test_missing_flashinfer_is_reported(monkeypatch):
+    def missing(_):
+        raise patch.PackageNotFoundError("flashinfer-python")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(patch, "version", missing)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="FlashInfer >= 0.6.18"):
+        patch.validate_flashinfer_version()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Synthetic SM90 regression from sgl-project/sglang#44014.
+
+Compile the backport in memory; never mutate the installed SGLang module.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+import pytest
+
+from areal.engine import sglang_gdn_decode_padding as patch
+
+torch = pytest.importorskip("torch")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.slow
+@pytest.mark.ci
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] == 9,
+    "Requires SM90",
+)
+class TestFlashInferGDNDecodePoolBackport(unittest.TestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        try:
+            patch.validate_flashinfer_version()
+        except RuntimeError as exc:
+            raise unittest.SkipTest(str(exc)) from exc
+        pytest.importorskip("sglang")
+        source = (patch.installed_sglang_root() / patch.TARGET_RELATIVE).read_bytes()
+        namespace = {"__name__": "areal_gdn_decode_backport_test"}
+        exec(
+            compile(patch.patched_source(source), "gdn_flashinfer.py", "exec"),
+            namespace,
+        )
+        cls.kernel = namespace["FlashInferGDNKernel"]()
+
+    def _inputs(self, state_dtype, index_dtype):
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        batch, heads, value_heads, dim, slots = 8, 4, 12, 128, 17
+        self.patterns = (
+            [1, 3, -1, 6, 9, -1, 12, 14],
+            [2, -1, 4, 5, -1, 7, 10, 13],
+        )
+        self.q, self.k = [
+            torch.randn(1, batch, heads, dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        self.v = torch.randn(
+            1, batch, value_heads, dim, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        self.a, self.b = [
+            torch.randn(1, batch, value_heads, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        self.A_log = torch.zeros(value_heads, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+        self.dt_bias = torch.zeros(value_heads, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.query_start_loc = torch.arange(batch + 1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+        self.original = torch.randn(
+            slots, value_heads, dim, dim, device="cuda", dtype=state_dtype
+        )
+        self.pool = self.original.clone()
+        self.indices = torch.tensor(self.patterns[0], device="cuda", dtype=index_dtype)
+
+    def _decode(self):
+        return self.kernel.decode(
+            self.q,
+            self.k,
+            self.v,
+            self.a,
+            self.b,
+            A_log=self.A_log,
+            dt_bias=self.dt_bias,
+            ssm_states=self.pool,
+            cache_indices=self.indices,
+            query_start_loc=self.query_start_loc,
+        )
+
+    def _reference(self, pattern):
+        from flashinfer.gdn_decode import gated_delta_rule_decode_pretranspose
+
+        rows = [i for i, slot in enumerate(pattern) if slot >= 0]
+        slots = [slot for slot in pattern if slot >= 0]
+        batch = len(rows)
+        output, state = gated_delta_rule_decode_pretranspose(
+            q=self.q[:, rows].contiguous().view(batch, 1, *self.q.shape[2:]),
+            k=self.k[:, rows].contiguous().view(batch, 1, *self.k.shape[2:]),
+            v=self.v[:, rows].contiguous().view(batch, 1, *self.v.shape[2:]),
+            state=self.original[slots].clone(),
+            A_log=self.A_log,
+            a=self.a[:, rows].contiguous().view(batch, 1, -1),
+            dt_bias=self.dt_bias,
+            b=self.b[:, rows].contiguous().view(batch, 1, -1),
+            use_qk_l2norm=True,
+        )
+        return rows, slots, output[:, 0], state
+
+    def _check(self, output, pattern, reference):
+        rows, slots, expected_output, expected_state = reference
+        untouched = [i for i in range(1, self.pool.shape[0]) if i not in slots]
+        # Slot zero is reserved; every other unused slot must remain unchanged.
+        # In particular, -1 padding must never alias the last real pool slot.
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(self.pool[untouched], self.original[untouched]))
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(self.pool[-1], self.original[-1]))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            self.pool[slots], expected_state, rtol=0.02, atol=0.02
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            output[0, rows], expected_output, rtol=0.02, atol=0.02
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(output[0, rows]).all().item())
+        if self.pool.dtype == torch.float32:
+            padding_rows = [i for i, slot in enumerate(pattern) if slot < 0]
+            self.assertEqual(torch.count_nonzero(output[0, padding_rows]).item(), 0)
+
+    def test_eager_padding(self):
+        for state_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+            for index_dtype in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
+                with self.subTest(state_dtype=state_dtype, index_dtype=index_dtype):
+                    self._inputs(state_dtype, index_dtype)
+                    reference = self._reference(self.patterns[0])
+                    self._check(self._decode(), self.patterns[0], reference)
+
+    def test_graph_replay_updates_indices(self):
+        for state_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+            for index_dtype in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
+                with self.subTest(state_dtype=state_dtype, index_dtype=index_dtype):
+                    self._inputs(state_dtype, index_dtype)
+                    references = [self._reference(p) for p in self.patterns]
+                    # Compile and warm the decode kernel before graph capture.
+                    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+                    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+                    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+                        for _ in range(3):
+                            self._decode()
+                    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+                    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                        output = self._decode()
+                    for pattern, reference in zip(self.patterns, references):
+                        self.pool.copy_(self.original)
+                        self.indices.copy_(
+                            torch.tensor(pattern, device="cuda", dtype=index_dtype)
+                        )
+                        graph.replay()
+                        self._check(output, pattern, reference)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
